'''Star-Dancing''' was a state experienced by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] that led to them feeling invigorated yet restless. Those capable of smelling the pheromones generated by the air during the act were truly able to understand the situation.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Cipher Nine]] met with the [[Joiner]] [[Vector Hyllus]] at a time when the nest was restless which he revealed was the result of Star-Dancing.
